what_nemo_does.item3_r3t: domqco.F90:209 dom_qco_r3c_RK3 computes r3t(ji,jj) = pssh(ji,jj) * r1_ht_0(ji,jj); domain.F90:158 sets r1_ht_0 = ssmask/(ht_0 + 1 - ssmask), i.e. exactly 1/ht_0 on a wet column. domzgr_substitute.h90:139 then forms e3t(i,j,k,t) = e3t_0(i,j,k)*(1+r3t(i,j,t)). Stage 3 recovers the stage-1 value: stprk3_stg.F90:156 CALL dom_qco_r3c_RK3(ssha,r3ta,...) and :231 r3t(:,:,Kaa) = r3ta(:,:). So NEMO forms the RATIO ssh/ht_0 FIRST and adds ONE; it never forms (ssh+ht_0)/ht_0.

what_legoesm_does_today: vertical.py compute_ocean_jacobian returns, on an OceanPartialCellCoordinate, J = (eta + H_bathy)/max(H_bathy,1e-10) -- the sum is rounded BEFORE the divide, so the low bits of the small ratio are lost to cancellation. Every live thickness on the NEMO cards is dz_ref * J.

PR1.claim: ITEM 3. Writing the stretch as NEMO writes it -- J = 1 + eta*(1/ht_0) in the ONE shared helper -- takes operand.dz_after from 5207/18000 at 1.136868e-13 to 0/18000 EXACT and dz_owner.r3t from 566/600 at 2.11758e-22 to 0/600 EXACT, GIVEN NEMO's own ssh.

PR2.claim: ITEM 3, Rule 12. LOCK_EXCHANGE-zco and OVERFLOW-zps DO execute the changed statement (both are key_qco cards), so neither is bit-identical before and after; every moved row is registered and no card's first-over-bar step moves EARLIER.
PR2.falsifier: any card's first-over-bar moves earlier, or a tank is claimed bit-identical without being measured.

PR3.claim: ITEM 1. The stage-3 momentum RHS residual is NOT inherited from the stage-3 input state. Re-measured at this tip, GYRE-zco.kt1.stage2.u and .v -- the operand stage 3 reads as uu(Kmm) -- stay AT-BAR at or below 2e-19 while the pre-dyn_ldf RHS is 2.06e-16 on 17383/17400, so the owner is inside the stage-3 operator arithmetic or its DERIVED geometry, not the state legoESM hands it.
PR3.falsifier: either stage-2 velocity row exceeds the 1e-15 bar.

PR4.claim: ITEM 1, the instrument's own control. legoESM's WRITE-only per-operator split at stage 3 (hpg, vorticity, advection) SUMS to the exposed pre-dyn_ldf total bit-exactly, 0 cells unequal on each face.
PR4.falsifier: any cell unequal -- then the exposure is not the production accumulation and no number from it is admissible.

PR5.claim: ITEM 1. NO OPERATOR IS PREDICTED TO OWN the 2.06e-16. The NEMO record that would score the stage-3 split does not exist -- oracle_rkstage2_terms is header-locked to kstg=2 (phase3_gate.py:286) and stage 3 has only the TOTAL pre-dyn_ldf frame. This round writes that record's frame spec and run.sh and does not run NEMO. The legoESM buckets are reported as SCALES that rank the relative error each operator would need to carry, labelled as such; naming an owner from them is forbidden.

PR6.claim: ITEM 2. The ranked owner of the kt=2 isoneutral fold (legoESM 1.17e-10 vs NEMO 3.39e-08, 289x, 17400/17400) is the mixed-layer index. NEMO's nmln/hmlp come from zdf_mxl's N2-INTEGRAL criterion (zdfmxl.F90:95-104, rho_c=0.01) run on the before state at stprk3.F90:165, and the GYRE card resolves legoESM's mld_criterion='rho_c', a potential-density-difference test referenced to a CELL CENTRE. ARM, one variable: rebuild the card with mld_criterion='n2_integral' and re-run round 39's kt2-given-inputs fold row. The arm moves that row's max relative (2.62947) by MORE than 10 per cent.
PR6.falsifier: it moves by less than 10 per cent -- the ranking is then REFUTED and the N2 operand or the limiter takes its place.
PR6.note: no landing this round: selecting the NEMO arm of an existing scheme knob on this card is an ASKED item and Rule 12 cannot discharge it without an ldf_slp record.

PR7.claim: ITEM 2. The round-38 kt=2 record cannot score any STATEMENT of ldf_slp, only the product ah_wslp2: it carries none of prd/rhd(Nbb), rn2b, nmln, hmlp, uslp, vslp, wslpi, wslpj, ahtu, ahtv, e3u_3d, e3v_3d, umask, vmask, wmask or ssmask.
PR7.falsifier: any of those is in the record's field list.
